name: What if my insurance company denies my hail damage claim?

mainEntity.name: What if my insurance company denies my hail damage claim?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your insurance company denies your initial hail damage claim, it doesn't always mean the damage isn't covered. Sometimes, a second review or additional documentation can lead to approval. Discounted Roofing Co. can help by providing a detailed professional assessment and advocating on your behalf. We often facilitate communication with adjusters, presenting our findings to help clarify the extent of the damage and support a successful re-evaluation of your claim.
acceptedAnswer.description: If your claim is denied, seek a second review. Discounted Roofing Co. can provide additional documentation and advocate with your adjuster for re-evaluation.
